books: Each skill book boosts XP for the level range defined by the game data.
Book sets (*Set) may contain all volumes of a series.
recipeSources: These items teach one or more crafting recipes according to LearnedRecipes in the game data.
vhs: This list contains VHS tapes with skill XP, recipe-learning effects, plus exceptional harmful tapes tracked by the checklist.
Retail VHS and Home VHS are grouped separately; multi-episode retail series get their own groups.
